title: Dexcom G6 - No valid timestamp stored for transmitter
symptom: After using a Dexcom G6 transmitter and sensor for the first time, no readings were received after the 2-hour warmup. Stopping and starting the sensor did not help, and eventually the sensor crashed and is now always Stopped. Logs show the message 'No valid timestamp stored for transmitter:8Gxxxx'.
evidence_quote: If I look at the logs I see severla times the message "No valid timestamp stored for transmitter:8Gxxxx"
